
Generated by PCT (POI Creation Tool)

Objects: 2

Install: copy this whole folder (keep its name) into your Aerofly FS 4 user
folder's scenery/poi/ , then restart Aerofly FS 4 and fly to the area:
  Windows: Documents\Aerofly FS 4\scenery\poi\
  macOS:   ~/Library/Application Support/Aerofly FS 4/scenery/poi/

Files: pct.tsl, pct.toc and pct_anchor.* are what PCT writes for Aerofly.
Files starting with two underscores (this README, the .json project copy)
are information only; Aerofly skips them.

Your own objects: put them in a file of your own in this folder, for
example user.tsl, beside your own TMB/TMA/TTX files. When PCT installs this
POI again it replaces only its own files and keeps yours.
